title: Derived state and store subscriptions: Keep one source of truth in Zustand and compute lightweight derived data from selected state; subscribe to stable slices rather than duplicating caches.
description: A complete Zustand 5 state-boundaries lesson using actual vanilla stores, targeted subscriptions and safe client state ownership, including a red starter and offline regression tests.
objectives: Keep one source of truth in Zustand and compute lightweight derived data from selected state; subscribe to stable slices rather than duplicating caches.
Repair the zustand-derived-subscription intentionally broken Zustand 5 starter.
Explain what belongs in local, URL or authoritative remote data state.
rubric: I can explain the state ownership principle for derived state and store subscriptions.
I can repair the 09.04.04 defect using actual Zustand 5 APIs.
I can identify persistence, privacy and hydration risks needing integration tests.
